01 / WHO WE ARE

Your Habesha community at Tech.

The Georgia Tech Eritrean-Ethiopian Student Association (GTEESA) brings our cultures to life through good food, dance, conversation, traditions, and time together. Come to a meeting, bring a friend, and make this community your own.

New to the culture? You’re welcome here, too.
